title.zh: 将高山省本格特副省Itogon市镇区改设为正式市镇，名称为Itogon市镇的法案
title.en: An Act to Convert the Municipal District of Itogon, Sub-province of Benguet Mountain Province, Into a Regular Municipality to Be Known as the Municipality of Itogon
title.orig: An Act to Convert the Municipal District of Itogon, Sub-province of Benguet Mountain Province, Into a Regular Municipality to Be Known as the Municipality of Itogon

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1951/ra_616_1951.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The municipal district of Itogon, sub-province of Benguet, Mountain Province, is hereby converted into a new municipality to be known as Municipality of Itogon.

The present municipal district mayor, vice-mayor, and councilors shall continue as such officials of the new municipality with the powers and duties of the same in regular municipalities and shall hold office until their successors shall have been elected and qualified.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, May 15, 1951.
